question: What is the primary purpose of the family planning referral method?

options.A: Punishing clients who fail to use basic contraceptive methods
options.B: Replacing primary health clinic services with hospital care
options.C: Reducing the overall number of children in Nigerian families
options.D: Linking clients to specialized contraceptive services not available locally

explanation: Referrals connect clients to advanced care or specific commodities that local primary clinics cannot supply. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h1)

question: Why is handing a client a referral slip without counseling insufficient?

options.A: Specialized facilities charge higher fees for unannounced clients
options.B: It often leads to clients dropping out of the care continuum
options.C: Primary nurses lack the authority to write referral slips
options.D: It violates federal health documentation policies in Nigeria

explanation: Without proper guidance and active linkage, clients frequently fail to reach the receiving facility and stop care. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h1)

question: A client requesting a bilateral tubal ligation must be referred because of...

options.A: The high cost of counseling at primary health centers
options.B: Mandatory laboratory tests for sexually transmitted infections
options.C: Standard policy requiring all women to visit tertiary hospitals
options.D: The need for a surgical facility and trained specialists

explanation: Permanent surgical methods require specialized operating rooms and surgical expertise absent in basic clinics. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h2)

question: When is a medical eligibility referral most critical for a family planning client?

options.A: When the client misses a single scheduled clinic appointment
options.B: When the client wants to change from pills to condoms
options.C: When basic commodities are temporarily out of stock
options.D: When underlying health conditions complicate safe contraceptive choice

explanation: Complex medical conditions require careful clinical evaluation to match the client with a safe method. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h2)

question: Which level of the referral network typically provides implant insertions in Nigeria?
explanation: General hospitals and comprehensive health centres at the secondary level routinely handle long-acting methods like implants. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h3)

question: Why do stable clients return downward from tertiary hospitals to primary health centres?

options.A: To free up hospital beds for surgical emergency cases
options.B: To receive routine method resupply closer to their homes
options.C: To undergo mandatory re-evaluation of their medical history
options.D: To comply with restrictions on long-term tertiary clinic visits

explanation: De-escalating stable clients reduces facility congestion and brings basic resupply services closer to the community. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h3)

question: The primary coordinator of the family planning referral pathway at the community level is the...
explanation: Community health nurses manage initial screenings, counseling, and logistical coordination for family planning referrals. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h4)

question: What is an essential post-referral duty of the community health nurse?

options.A: Changing the client's chosen contraceptive method arbitrarily
options.B: Following up to confirm if the client reached the receiving facility
options.C: Visiting the secondary hospital to assist with surgical procedures
options.D: Reimbursement of transportation costs incurred by the client

explanation: Tracking ensures that clients do not get lost between the primary site and the referral center. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h4)

question: What must be included on a completed family planning referral form?

options.A: Vital signs, clinical notes, and reason for referral
options.B: The client's bank account details and employment status
options.C: A comprehensive family tree dating back three generations
options.D: Signatures of all local community leaders in the area

explanation: Receiving clinicians need accurate clinical baseline data to understand why the client was sent. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h5)

question: A client is scheduled for a referral but expresses fear of traveling to a large general hospital. What should the nurse do first?

options.A: Send her to a tertiary teaching hospital instead of a general hospital
options.B: Threaten to report her to community elders if she refuses to go
options.C: Listen to her concerns and provide clear directions and reassurance
options.D: Cancel the referral and force her to accept oral contraceptive pills

explanation: Addressing emotional barriers and practical travel fears reduces anxiety and improves referral completion rates. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h5)

question: What document is sent back by the receiving facility to confirm a client arrived?
explanation: The feedback slip completes the communication loop between the referring and receiving facilities. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h6)

question: Why must the referring clinic retain a duplicate copy of the referral form?

options.A: To maintain accurate registry records and track outstanding clients
options.B: To prevent the receiving facility from overcharging the client
options.C: To satisfy tax collection agencies operating within the health zone
options.D: To ensure the nurse receives a financial bonus for every referral

explanation: Duplicate copies allow nurses to monitor who was sent out and follow up on missing feedback reports. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h6)

question: Which factor is a major financial barrier to completing a family planning referral?

options.A: Excessive availability of free taxi services
options.C: High transport costs and hospital fees
options.D: Low salaries paid to community health nurses

explanation: Out-of-pocket expenses for travel and hospital services frequently prevent clients from following through on referrals. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h7)

question: How can community health nurses help overcome the barrier of partner disapproval?

options.A: By reporting uncooperative husbands to the local police station
options.B: By involving male partners in family planning health education sessions
options.C: By offering financial incentives to husbands who permit contraception
options.D: By bypassing the husband entirely and keeping all care confidential

explanation: Engaging men directly addresses household resistance and fosters joint reproductive decision-making. [learn more](GNS225_U3_T6#GNS225_U3_T6_h7)
